title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Orange Pineapple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Orange Pineapple delivers a bold and sun-drenched fusion of citrus and tropical fruit. The bright, tangy notes of freshly squeezed Oranges provide a lively zest, while juicy Pineapple brings a deep, golden sweetness with a subtly tart edge. The result is a vibrant and refreshing vape bursting with fruity intensity. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Orange Pineapple is designed to capture the bold and layered flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a lasting, full-bodied taste while delivering a consistently satisfying vaping experience. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid offers a balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their dedication to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a leading name in the vaping industry. Please Note: This E-Liquid may contain Ice
